I have to work the crowd, Commander. Maybe we can do lunch sometime.
Commander. Have you changed you mind? Terra Firma could use your support in the election.
If we don't stand up for ourselves, no one else will.
Perhaps so, Commander. But if aliens feel free to express their "opinions" at gunpoint, why shouldn't we?
We should. But you're looking for a reason.
I disagree. We have a backlog of grievances the aliens have ignored. Starting with Shanxi.
Were you at Shanxi? If not, shut your piehole.
Right. I read you, skipper.
Aye, aye, Commander.
No ma'am. Sorry ma'am.
No sir. Sorry, sir.
Because they have bigger guns?
If they have bigger guns, we should increase military spending. Instead, we sign away our right to defend ourselves with treaties.
I like the way you think.
What happened at the mass relay was a misunderstanding. If you saw a child about to touch a gun, wouldn't you stop them?
What happened at the mass relay was a misunderstanding. If you saw a child about to touch a gun, wouldn't you stop them?
What happened at the mass relay was a misunderstanding. If you saw a child about to touch a gun, wouldn't you stop them?
I'd pull them away, yes. I wouldn't shoot them dead.
We all serve in our own way, Commander. I'm not a soldier. But I can tell the public why they should support your efforts.
Wearing a ribbon on your lapel makes you a hero, huh? You want to help humanity? Get out of your office and pitch in.
So you can say "I support our troops" and get into office because of our sacrifices, huh?
Shepard's actions speak for themselves.
Among my people, everyone's a soldier. Even the infirm volunteer to serve behind the front lines.
Next you're going to ask for a picture together with Shepard. So you can show people how close you are to the military.
I-- I assure you, I'm only interested in the betterment of humanity. The same as you, Commander.
I'm seeking one of the five spacer seats in Parliament. They have certain baroque conditions for a citizen to be able to vote for them.
You have to spend more than six months a year in space. But you can't have stayed in any one settled system for more than a month.
You do spend most of your time in space, Commander.
It's gratifying to hear that.
We can't allow anything like Shanxi to happen again.
Since I have your vote, could I convince you to issue a public statement of support for my candidacy?
I don't suppose I could convince you to issue a public statement of support for my candidacy?
The support of the first human Spectre would be invaluable.
I understand. I'm glad you support the democratic process, at least.
It's still a powerful symbol, Commander. Shanxi is the only human territory ever occupied by an alien species.
Excellent. I'll have my people contact you. Don't worry, we'll take care of everything.
Of course. I apologize for making the request.
Thank you for your time, Commander. Remember Terra Firma on election day. Because Terra Firma remembers you.
Your support would mean a lot, Commander.
Excuse me? You're the Spectre, right?
Shepard! Commander Shepard!
Come on! I just want to talk!
Commander Shepard. It's an honor to speak with you.
I'm Charles Saracino of the Terra Firma Party. With Armistice Day coming soon, we're making our voices heard by the alien-appeasers on the Presidium.
Can I count on your support in the next election?
We've heard that before in human history. Well-meaning naivete leads to declarations of "peace in our time."
Our core value is that Earth must "stand firm" against alien influences. Politically, culturally, and--in the worst case--militarily.
It's a noble goal. Too bad so many of your supporters are just racists.
It's a good theory, but these people are making it sound like a racial issue.
I can't deny that some of our supporters have extreme views. But our platform is also supported by economists, sociologists, and medical professionals.
Of course not, Commander. Whether I disagree with them or not, they have the right to express their opinion.
Of course, Commander.
Of course, Commander.
That is not unreasonable. But some of the things these people are saying sound a bit bigoted.
Glad to see some humans growing a backbone.
But many of your subordinates make this a point of race, not politics.
Excuse me. I don't believe human politics are any of your business.
What the Alliance does affects everyone around it.
My business is whatever I say it is.
Turian space borders yours. Of course we're concerned about your leadership.
No, of course not. My apologies. I only meant to point out that other species have no right to interfere in Alliance politics.
Of course, Shepard.
Whatever.
Yes, Commander.
Very well, Commander. My apologies.
As we have every year, for the last 26 years. The war taught humanity a lesson that some would forget.
What's this demonstration about?
Cram your honor. What's this riot about?
You obviously wanted to speak to me.
Sorry. I believe we need to work peacefully with other races.
I don't know Terra Firma's platform. What do you stand for?
But you don't do anything to curtail the the racist comments of your members.
I don't think it's "extreme" to stand up for our inalienable human rights. No pun intended.
A few extremists don't invalidate the whole party, Chief. Every group has bad apples.
A few extremists don't invalidate the whole party, Lieutenant. Every group has bad apples.
We live in this galaxy, Mr. Saracino. We can't pretend that what we do affects no one else.
Stay out of this.
Enough. Both of you.
You're marking the end of the First Contact War with a protest?
I thought the lesson of the First Contact War was that there's other life in the galaxy, and they have opinions too.
It's not worth getting angry over, Chief.
Gunnery Chief Williams, is that the proper way to address a civilian authority?
Every day I stand up for humanity. Often in the face of bullets. What have you done lately? You really think speeches help?
What are you running for?
I'm a patriot, Mr. Saracino. You've got my vote.
You have the right to your opinion, Mr. Saracino. But with all due respect, I disagree with it.
The occupation of Shanxi couldn't happen again. We weren't even sure there were aliens to garrison against back then.
We need more politicians with the courage to stand up for human rights.
It's inappropriate for an active-duty officer to publicly comment on politics.
I'll think about it. Excuse me.
I don't think so.
Thanks.
Explain yourself.
What do you want?
The "appeasers" are right.
Terra Firma
Armistice Day
Election
Earth must walk alone.
Goodbye.
That's no excuse.
Maybe they're right.
That is true.
That is true.
There's a bigger picture.
Quiet.
Stop arguing.
Then you've learned nothing.
You're useless.
Ease down, Williams.
Secure that!
I won't support you.
Shanxi
You have my support.
I can't support you.
Big place.
That your professional opinion, sir?
